name: accordion-multiple
title: Accordion multiple
description: Sections that open independently, with one disabled.

files.content:
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionHeader, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, } from '@/ui/accordion/accordion'; /** * Sections that open independently, with `multiple`. One is disabled, * and the open sections are bound to a signal. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-accordion-multiple', imports: [ Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionHeader, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, NdIcon, ], template: `

Your name, photo and bio.

Managed by your organization.

Password and two-factor authentication.
`, }) export class AccordionMultipleExample { protected readonly open = signal(['profile', 'security']); }
